content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["The film seemed rushed and muddled, lacking emotional impact.", "Flashbacks were too fleeting and confusing, even for readers of the book.", "Lead actresses were one-note and lacked subtlety, with no chemistry between them.", "A critical third character was introduced minimally at the end, making her role feel clumsy.", "The male filmmakers repeatedly referred to female characters as \"girls\" and made simplistic statements about female needs and desires.", "The project would have benefited from having women at the helm."]}
